description: This file provides functions for CSV serialization and deserialization, primarily for use within the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP. It includes utilities for converting recordsets to CSV format, reading CSV files into recordsets, and managing file-based caching with locking.

classes.name: ADORecordSet
classes.description: A class representing a database recordset, used in CSV serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: ADOConnection
classes.description: A class representing a database connection, used in methods that access database attributes.

classes.name: ADOFieldObject
classes.description: A class representing metadata about a database field.

methods.name: _rs2serialize
methods.description: Converts a recordset into a serialized CSV format, including metadata headers.

methods.name: csv2rs
methods.description: Reads a CSV file or URL and converts it into an ADORecordSet object, supporting cache formats and timeouts.

methods.name: adodb_write_file
methods.description: Saves contents to a file with file locking and optional debugging, supporting cross-platform safety.
